crossRefs.note: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.
They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from…
David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him…
therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes…
Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
translations.bsb: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a void in the tribes of Israel.
translations.kjv: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
translations.asv: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that Jehovah had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
